name: Ivo Dominguez Jr
reason: Too thin on his own pages: ivodominguezjr.com (read 6 Nov 2026; contact@ivodominguezjr.com and a usable photo are there) lists no offerings of his own with their own page (only other organisations' 2027 conferences and an online ritual series that began in September 2026), links no YouTube channel, and gives no ISBNs for his books (Witch's Sun Sign series, Spirit Speak and others, published by Llewellyn and Weiser); two searches found no publisher page with ISBNs, only retailers. Wiccan elder and astrologer, in scope otherwise; co-author of Pisces Witch with Mat Auryn (rank 200).
